_comment: English art briefs per character id from game.json characters[]. 'design_sk' is copied from game.json for traceability; 'description' is what goes into prompts. Ages are locked per sheet.

ADAM.design_sk: Modrá pracovná bunda, horčicové tričko, hnedá brašna, krátke tmavé vlasy; rúško v 2020 vonku pri ľuďoch. Žiadna podoba s postavami Polda.
ADAM.description: Adam, a 35-year-old Slovak man who repairs audio equipment for a living: an ordinary, likeable civilian with a dry sense of humour. Short dark brown hair, clean-shaven with a hint of stubble, friendly slightly tired face, medium build, average height. He wears an open mid-blue cotton work jacket with chest pockets and the sleeves pushed up a little, a plain mustard-yellow T-shirt underneath, dark grey-blue jeans, and sturdy brown leather shoes. A brown leather messenger bag hangs on a strap across his chest and rests on his left hip. No hat, no coat, no tie, no uniform, no badge.

variants.mask2020: Outdoors among people in 2020 he wears a light blue disposable surgical face mask over his nose and mouth.

ELA.design_sk: Zelená vesta, rúško, dva rôzne perá, pevná doska.
ELA.description: Ela, a 40-year-old Slovak woman who coordinates volunteers in 2020: brisk, matter-of-fact and kind. Shoulder-length brown hair tied back in a low ponytail, a plain bright green padded vest without any logo or text over a grey long-sleeved top, dark trousers and comfortable trainers. A light blue disposable surgical face mask covers her nose and mouth. Two different pens (one red, one black) are clipped to the vest pocket and she holds a sturdy brown clipboard against her side.
